gate_definition: PhyNetCNN.Model.forward computes g = gating_network(cat(xrd_features, phys_features)); gated_xrd_features = g * xrd_features and gated_phys_features = (1 - g) * phys_features. Larger gate_weight means stronger scaling of the CNN/XRD branch and weaker scaling of the peak/physical-feature branch. It is a scalar feature gate, not a calibrated branch probability.
notes: Deterministic raw opXRD evaluation split; augmentation disabled. This run is for per-sample analysis only and must not be used to select a best checkpoint.
